########################################
#
# Script contains subsampling analysis comparing consensus sequences generated
# across severall subsamples from the same UMI-SPBC group (S1_ONT_Q17) and compared
# V-region identity between subsample-consensus and consensus sequence of the 
# full group. This group shows the matching group (CGAGGAGCTTCCATATCTAAAGTCAGTA) between
# S1_ONT_Q17 and S1_PB_Q17 what is shown in Fig 4e
#
# Comparison falls in the FWR1-FWR4 region, matching anchors and productivity status
# are determined by pasting the consensus sequences into IgBLAST
#
# Results are shown in LongAIRR Fig. S3
#
########################################


```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Biostrings)
library(msa)
library(stringdist)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(tibble)
library(pwalign)
```

---------------------------------Function setup---------------------------------

helper for edge case to determine hamming distance
```{r}
compute_hamming_similarity <- function(seq1, seq2, trim_start = 0, trim_end = 0) {
  alignment <- msa(c(seq1, seq2), method = "Muscle")
  aligned <- as.character(alignment)
  start <- trim_start + 1
  end <- nchar(aligned[[1]]) - trim_end
  trimmed1 <- substr(aligned[[1]], start, end)
  trimmed2 <- substr(aligned[[2]], start, end)
  hamming <- stringdist(trimmed1, trimmed2, method = "hamming")
  percent <- 100 - (hamming / nchar(trimmed2)) * 100
  return(c(hamming = hamming, similarity_percent = percent))
}
```


```{r}
compute_motif_similarity <- function(gt_seq, query_seq,
                                     constant_motif, fwr1_motif,
                                     max_mismatch = 2,
                                     min_query_frac = 0.9,
                                     gap_open = 10, gap_ext = 4) {
  
  # convert to character
  gt_seq <- as.character(gt_seq)[[1]]
  query_seq <- as.character(query_seq)[[1]]
  
  # find constant / variable motifs in gt
  start_gt <- matchPattern(constant_motif, gt_seq, with.indels = TRUE)
  stop_gt <- matchPattern(fwr1_motif, gt_seq, with.indels = TRUE)
  
  # find constant / variable motifs in subsamples
  start_sub <- matchPattern(constant_motif, query_seq, max.mismatch = max_mismatch)
  stop_sub <- matchPattern(fwr1_motif, query_seq, max.mismatch = max_mismatch)
  
  if (length(start_gt) == 0 || length(stop_gt) == 0 ||
      length(start_sub) == 0 || length(stop_sub) == 0) {
    stop("Could not find motifs in one of the sequences")
  }
  
  # trim sequences based on motif boundaries
  trimmed_gt <- substr(gt_seq, start(start_gt)[1], end(stop_gt)[length(stop_gt)])
  trimmed_query <- substr(query_seq, start(start_sub)[1], end(stop_sub)[length(stop_sub)])
  
  len_gt <- nchar(trimmed_gt)
  len_query <- nchar(trimmed_query)
  
  # info if too much was trimmed off the subsample
  if (len_query < len_gt * min_query_frac) {
    stop(sprintf("Query too short: query length = %d, ground truth length = %d (must be ≥%.0f%% of GT)",
                 len_query, len_gt, min_query_frac * 100))
  }
  
  # align trimmed sequences (subsamples with gt)
  aln <- pairwiseAlignment(pattern = trimmed_query, subject = trimmed_gt,
                           type = "global", gapOpening = gap_open, gapExtension = gap_ext)
  
  # aligned_gt <- as.character(Biostrings::subject(aln))
  # aligned_query <- as.character(Biostrings::pattern(aln))
  aligned_gt <- as.character(alignedSubject(aln))
  aligned_query <- as.character(alignedPattern(aln))
  
  stopifnot(nchar(aligned_gt) == nchar(aligned_query))
  
  # compute Hamming distance & percent similarity
  hamming <- stringdist(aligned_gt, aligned_query, method = "hamming")
  similarity <- 100 - (hamming / nchar(aligned_gt)) * 100
  
  return(c(hamming = hamming, similarity_percent = similarity))
}

```

-------------------------------use functions

```{r, warning=FALSE}
results_sp12_ig_masked <- list()
results_sp12_ig_masked$gt <- compute_hamming_similarity(sp12_ig_gt, sp12_ig_gt)

for (size in names(sp12_ig_paths[])) {
  for (rep_id in names(sp12_ig_paths[[size]])) {
    seq <- Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(sp12_ig_paths[[size]][[rep_id]])
    sim_result_masked <- compute_motif_similarity(
      gt_seq = sp12_ig_gt,
      query_seq = seq,
      constant_motif = "GAGGAGACGGTGACCAGGGT",
      fwr1_motif = "AGACTGCACCAACTGCACCT",
      max_mismatch = 6
    )
    results_sp12_ig_masked[[paste(size, rep_id, sep = "_")]] <- sim_result_masked
  }
}

results_sp12_ig_rec <- results_sp12_ig_masked
```

```{r}
results_ont_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(results_sp12_ig_rec), function(name) {
                                          parts <- strsplit(name, "_")[[1]]
                                          n_val <- parts[1]
                                          rep_val <- parts[2]
                                          df <- as.data.frame(t(results_sp12_ig_rec[[name]]))
                                          df$n <- n_val
                                          df$replicate <- rep_val
                                          df
                                        }))
```

```{r}
# Find position of the first gt row
insert_pos <- which(results_ont_df$n == "gt" & results_ont_df$replicate == "s1")[1]

# Create new df by row binding manually
results_ont_df <- bind_rows(results_ont_df[1:insert_pos, ], new_rows, results_ont_df[(insert_pos + 1):nrow(results_ont_df), ])
```

add productivty information
```{r}
results_df_prod <- results_ont_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(hamming, similarity_percent), 
               names_to = "metric", 
               values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(group = paste(n, replicate, sep = "_"), n_numeric = as.numeric(gsub("n", "", n)),
         n_numeric = ifelse(n == "gt", max(n_numeric, na.rm = TRUE) + 1000, n_numeric)) %>%
  left_join(productivity_info, by = c("n", "replicate"))
```

shared theme for suppsampling figures
```{r}
theme_subsample <- theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey88"),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.2),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    strip.text   = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.2),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))
```

subsample figure
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
p_percent_rec_large <- ggplot(filter(results_df_prod, metric == "similarity_percent"),
  aes(x = n_ordered, y = value, color = productive)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, color = "darkgreen", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_jitter(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.85, shape = 20, width = 0.2, height = 0) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#6aa84f", "FALSE" = "#cc0000", "NA" = "gray")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(NA, 100)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = function(x) seq(floor(min(x)), ceiling(max(x)), by = 0.2)) +
  labs(x = "Number of reads", y = "Consensus identity (%)", color = "Productive") +
  theme_subsample +
  guides(color = "none")
```

in-figure legend
```{r}
legend_df_large <- tibble::tibble(
  x_sq   = 3,                         # x for the colored square
  x_lab  = 3,                         # x for the label box (to the right)
  y      = c(98.4, 98.2),              # y positions in your proportion scale
  fill   = c("#6aa84f", "#cc0000"),
  label  = c(paste0("  Productive "), paste0("  Non-productive ")))


legend_df_large$x_sq <- factor(as.character(legend_df_large$x_sq), levels = levels(results_df_prod$n_ordered))

legend_df_large$x_lab <- factor(as.character(legend_df_large$x_lab), levels = levels(results_df_prod$n_ordered))

group_df_large <- tibble(x_lab = factor("3", levels = levels(results_df_prod$n_ordered)),y = 98.6, label = "S1_ONT_Q17 Group: CGAGGAGCTTCCATATCTAAAGTCAGTA")

s3_d <- p_percent_rec_large +
  geom_label(data = group_df_large, aes(x = x_lab, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = 1.5, fill = "gray91", colour = "black",
    label.size = 0, label.r = unit(0.15, "lines"), label.padding = unit(0.12, "lines"), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_label(data = legend_df_large, aes(x = x_lab, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = 1.5, fill = "gray91", colour = "black",
    label.size = 0, label.r = unit(0.15, "lines"), label.padding = unit(0.12, "lines"), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = legend_df_large, aes(x = x_sq, y = y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = I(legend_df_large$fill), shape = 20, size = 1.5, show.legend = FALSE)
```
